cards.front: incisor
cards.back: A flat, sharp front tooth used for cutting food.
cards.say: incisor. A flat, sharp front tooth used for cutting food. We use incisors to bite an apple.

cards.front: canine
cards.back: A pointed tooth used for tearing food.
cards.say: canine. A pointed tooth used for tearing food. Canines help us tear meat.

cards.front: molar
cards.back: A big, flat tooth at the back used for grinding food.
cards.say: molar. A big, flat tooth at the back used for grinding food. We chew bread with our molars.

cards.front: premolar
cards.back: A tooth between the canines and molars that helps to crush and grind food.
cards.say: premolar. A tooth between the canines and molars that helps to crush and grind food.

cards.front: Which teeth cut food?
cards.back: Incisors.
cards.say: Which teeth cut food? Incisors.

cards.front: Which teeth tear food?
cards.back: Canines.
cards.say: Which teeth tear food? Canines.

cards.front: Which teeth grind food?
cards.back: Molars.
cards.say: Which teeth grind food? Molars.

cards.front: Which teeth are at the very front of your mouth?
cards.back: Incisors.
cards.say: Which teeth are at the very front of your mouth? Incisors.

cards.front: Which teeth are at the back of your mouth?
cards.back: Molars.
cards.say: Which teeth are at the back of your mouth? Molars.

cards.front: enamel
cards.back: The hard, white outer layer of a tooth that protects it.
cards.say: enamel. The hard, white outer layer of a tooth that protects it.

cards.front: decay
cards.back: When a tooth is damaged by acid made from sugar and bacteria.
cards.say: decay. When a tooth is damaged by acid made from sugar and bacteria. Sweets can cause tooth decay.

cards.front: plaque
cards.back: A sticky film of bacteria on teeth.
cards.say: plaque. A sticky film of bacteria on teeth. Brushing removes plaque.

cards.front: Why is sugar bad for teeth?
cards.back: Bacteria turn sugar into acid, and the acid damages the enamel.
cards.say: Why is sugar bad for teeth? Bacteria turn sugar into acid, and the acid damages the enamel.

cards.front: Which drink is better for teeth, water or fizzy drink?
cards.back: Water. Fizzy drinks have sugar and acid.
cards.say: Which drink is better for teeth, water or fizzy drink? Water. Fizzy drinks have sugar and acid.

cards.front: How often should you brush your teeth?
cards.back: Twice a day, for two minutes each time.
cards.say: How often should you brush your teeth? Twice a day, for two minutes each time.

cards.front: Why should you see a dentist?
cards.back: A dentist checks teeth and fixes problems early.
cards.say: Why should you see a dentist? A dentist checks teeth and fixes problems early.

cards.front: Why do we use toothpaste with fluoride?
cards.back: Fluoride helps make enamel stronger.
cards.say: Why do we use toothpaste with fluoride? Fluoride helps make enamel stronger.

cards.front: What does flossing do?
cards.back: It removes food and plaque from between teeth.
cards.say: What does flossing do? It removes food and plaque from between teeth.

cards.front: What are the first set of teeth called?
cards.back: Milk teeth (baby teeth).
cards.say: What are the first set of teeth called? Milk teeth, also called baby teeth.

cards.front: How many milk teeth do most children have?
cards.back: Twenty.
cards.say: How many milk teeth do most children have? Twenty.

cards.front: How many adult teeth do most adults have?
cards.back: Thirty-two, including wisdom teeth.
cards.say: How many adult teeth do most adults have? Thirty-two, including wisdom teeth.

cards.front: What happens to milk teeth?
cards.back: They come out and adult teeth grow in.
cards.say: What happens to milk teeth? They come out and adult teeth grow in.

cards.front: Which food is better for teeth, an apple or a sweet?
cards.back: An apple. A sweet has much more sugar.
cards.say: Which food is better for teeth, an apple or a sweet? An apple. A sweet has much more sugar.

cards.front: True or false: Adult teeth grow back if they come out.
cards.back: False. Adult teeth do not grow back, so we must look after them.
cards.say: True or false: Adult teeth grow back if they come out. False. Adult teeth do not grow back, so we must look after them.

cards.front: Which animal has large canines for tearing meat?
cards.back: A lion or tiger. They are meat eaters.
cards.say: Which animal has large canines for tearing meat? A lion or tiger. They are meat eaters.
